mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months reduces discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% in a single month signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) over 2 months reduces consumer purchasing power, depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in benefit expansion periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below 100,000 over 2 months signals labor market strength, boosting consumer confidence and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in benefit contraction periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 over 2 months indicates expanding domestic demand, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in production expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 over 2 months signals softening demand, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in production contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales (HOUST) above 1400 over 2 months indicates strong consumer demand, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in sales expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1300 over 2 months signals weak consumer demand, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in sales contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
